description: Dependency-neutral executable contract for synchronous iterator acquisition, next results, for-of and a bounded IteratorClose subset.

collectionUnsupportedEvidence.interpretation: Each row counts per-execution PBT outcomes for arrays.ts::forEach in one frozen report. It is not a count of unique targets and the two rows must not be summed into 50 targets.

unsupported.reason: Symbol.asyncIterator and for-await-of are outside the synchronous iterator contract.
Generator suspension and yield require the separate spread/yield capability and are not implemented by iterator support alone.
yield-star delegation combines generator suspension with iterator forwarding and closing.
User iterator mutation of its iterable or prototype during next requires a side-effect probe.
Map and Set additions/deletions while an iterator is live are not part of the frozen insertion-order subset.
Reentrant next or return calls can observe partially updated iterator state.
Proxy get/apply traps around Symbol.iterator can mutate state and throw before iterator acquisition.
Exact TypeError behavior when next returns a primitive is outside the result-only subset.
Abrupt return and non-object return results require exact completion-precedence handling.
Iterator helpers such as map, filter and take are not required for the frozen real targets.
